The paper introduces a dataset, but it also benchmarks it with a RAG-based approach on LLaMa2 and LLaMa3. That counts as running experiments with a RAG system. E2 excludes dataset papers only when they have no new RAG experiments, so it does not apply here. The abstract is brief about the RAG details, but it states the benchmarking directly, so I include it.
